tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Coinbase tokenized stocks on Base that keldrin tracks: symbol, contract address, current multiplier (WAD) and whether a verified Chainlink NAV feed exists. Optional `query` filters by symbol or name.

tools.name: get_corporate_actions
tools.description: Verified dividends, splits and multiplier changes for one token, applied and upcoming: multiplier before/after (WAD), effective time, SEC filing, onchain tx and evidence links. Balances never change; the multiplier does.

tools.name: get_nav_history
tools.description: Official Chainlink total-return NAV history for one token, each point with feed, phase, aggregator and round id (re-readable with getRoundData). interval=daily gives the last official in-session round per NYSE trading day; interval=round gives every official round. Missing days are listed, never fil

tools.name: get_risk
tools.description: Volatility (30- and 60-day, annualized), max drawdown (since the first official close and over the last 90 closes, with peak and trough round ids) and 1/5/20-day returns, computed from official Chainlink total-return NAV daily closes. Facts from history, not a forecast or advice.

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: The company's earnings releases for a tokenized stock: SEC Form 8-K filings listing item 2.02 (Results of Operations), with SEC's exact acceptance time and links to the filing. Each re-checked against the filing's own headers on www.sec.gov. Facts only: no estimates or predicted dates.

tools.name: get_market_context
tools.description: US session now (open/pre/after/closed/weekend/holiday), next open/close, the latest Chainlink NAV read live with round id and age, staleness (fresh / expected_closed / unexpectedly_stale), and the main DEX price with its gap vs NAV. The NAV is the last published reference, not a live equity price.

tools.name: get_dex_price
tools.description: Live DEX price of one token read onchain at one block from keldrin's verified pools (Uniswap v3, Aerodrome, Slipstream, plain Uniswap v4 vs USDC/WETH/ETH): price per token in USD, estimated 2% depth, the main (deepest usable) pool and every pool's status.

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Every Coinbase tokenized stock on Base with a verified Chainlink NAV feed: latest NAV with round id, freshness, main DEX price with gap vs NAV, next corporate action, plus the US session. Uses the caller's 3 free snapshots/reports per day; after that it returns the paid x402 link ($0.05 USDC on Base

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Corporate actions with evidence, market context (live NAV, freshness, DEX gap), 30 daily NAV closes with round ids and every verified DEX pool, for one token. Uses the caller's 3 free snapshots/reports per day; after that it returns the paid x402 link and never pays by itself.

tools.name: get_market_session
tools.description: Whether the US stock market is open right now, with next open/close and last close (NYSE calendar 2026-2027; beyond it: calendar_not_covered).
